messages:
alex: FYI I got paged 1769000000 for high tail latency on hosted-api in us-west. Investigating now. :rotating_light:
alex: Initial check - autoscaler healthy, but p99 token gen spikes for model-redwood-xl on shard-3. Seeing steady 5xxs from router. Adding traces to the incident.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED #INC-4821 — severity: high — impacted: Hosted API (us-west) — paging: @alex @priya
alex: @priya can you grab secondary if you're available? I'm attaching quick logs below.
alex: ```
[2026-03-14T13:00:01Z] router-3 ERROR upstream 502 backend-redis timeout
[2026-03-14T13:00:02Z] model-srv-3 WARN kvcache miss spike 78% seq=512
[2026-03-14T13:05:12Z] autoscaler INFO scale_up event triggered -> 2 -> 4
```
priya: on my way, will take secondary. Jumping into the traces.
priya: Quick note — customer impact looks like intermittent 502s for generation endpoints with >256 tokens. Affected customers: two PLG tenants with long chat sessions, maybe 3rd-party webhook retries.
amaya: (bot message) added incident context and attached the running logs.
miguel: Reassigning primary to @priya, I'll stay on backup for now. Coverage: I'm available for escalation until 15:30 PT.
priya: Working hypothesis: KV cache eviction thresh on shard-3 + backend redis latency. Running runbook step 1-3 now (cold start mitigation + scale).
priya: runbook snippet for reference:
```
# Runbook: slow-generation-high-5xx
1) Check router qps: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=router -o wide`
2) If 502s from redis, failover to replica: `redis-cli -h redis-proxy-2 --failover`
3) Temporarily pin model to lower batch size: set config `/api/v1/configs/model-redwood-xl/batch_size=8`
4) Notify CS and enable graceful-fallback to smaller model variant
```
alex: I kicked a temporary route fallback to redwood-xl-quant which reduced 5xxs, but latency is slightly higher for long sequences.
priya: I'm scaling the KV cache capacity on shard-3 and applying redis replica failover. Executing: `redis-cli --replicaof redis-replica-7`
oncall-bot: ACTION LOGGED — ticket INC-4821 updated with runbook steps and mitigation attempts.
miguel: Noting a coverage gap: Jamie is out for the next 2 hours (OOO) so after 15:30 PT we have no on-prem specialist for private deployments. Suggest short rota shift if this persists.
jamie: Confirmed OOO for customer on-call, returning after 17:30 PT. If we need on-prem access, tag me async but I won't be in the primary rotation.
priya: Mitigations holding — 502s dropped to baseline, p99 latency trending down. Marking incident as partially mitigated.
alex: Posting a brief customer-facing note to support: "We're mitigating increased 502s for generation endpoints; teams are rolling fixes and we've applied temporary fallbacks. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
priya: Filing follow-ups: creating two tickets — one to root cause redis latency (TCK-991) and one for permanent KV cache sizing change (TCK-992).
priya: ``Ticket: TCK-991 (root cause) - created: https://issue.tracker/redwood/TCK-991``
priya: ``Ticket: TCK-992 (kvcache sizing) - created: https://issue.tracker/redwood/TCK-992``
miguel: Scheduling retrospective: tentative 1-hour postmortem at 2026-03-15T16:00Z. I'll create calendar invite and link in the tickets.
priya: Action items summary:
- priya: finish RC analysis for redis latency (due 2026-03-16)
- miguel: create retro invite + collect traces (due 2026-03-15)
- alex: follow up with CS on impacted tenants and draft customer communication (due EOD)
- jamie: review on-prem fallback playbook when back (no blocker)
alex: Handoff: I'm stepping out at 14:00 PT. @priya you are primary until 17:30 PT. miguel will be backup until 15:30 PT, after that coverage is limited — recommend escalation to SRE lead if anything high pops.
priya: Acknowledged, taking primary. Will post hourly updates in this thread and mark when fully resolved.
miguel: Thanks all. Leaving notes in TCK tickets about the temporary config change and rollback plan.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — INC-4821 severity downgraded to medium, mitigations applied, follow-ups filed.
priya: final note before I close the handoff: if latency creeps up again, immediate steps are to revert fallback (rollback model pin) and re-route traffic away from shard-3. See runbook step 4 for fallback commands.
alex: Great. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
priya: Closing handoff thread — I will file final postmortem summary in TCK-991 once RC done. :white_check_mark:
